newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open off 0.20 to 0.40 cent.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open off 0.20 to 0.40 cent.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open down 0.20 to 0.40 cent Tuesday, with overnight trading on LME quiet as the market consolidated after its recent strong gains which pushed tags into overbought territory on the charts.
LME stocks fell a modest 650 tonnes Tuesday to 137,025 tonnes.
COMEX and LME were both closed Monday.
COMEX stocks on Friday rose 1,083 short tons to 40,490 short tons.
On overnight ACCESS, COMEX July copper last traded at 118.15 cents a lb versus Friday's finish of 118.75 cents.
The LME backwardation was $72/$77, slightly weaker from Friday.
